title: Boardroom Tea: SEC Chair Francis Lim’s struggle to add financial literacy as a standalone subject in schools
summary: A financially literate nation, he believes, won’t just deepen capital markets by teaching students how markets work. It will also protect everyone from scams and wanton spending.
